title: Wall-Mounting Labor Charge Calculation for Northgate TV Delivery & Wall-Mount Installation
content:
The wall-mounting charge on a Northgate Delivery & Installation appointment at the Northgate TV Delivery & Wall-Mount Installation level is the service level's wall-mount labor fee for each television mounted, every television at the full labor fee. The charge is rounded to the cent once, at the end, half up.

## The quantities

1. **Televisions mounted** — the television units sold on the purchase being delivered less the television units returned from it.
2. **Wall-mount labor fee** — the service level's fee for mounting one television on the wall, as the level's installation figures state it.
3. **Charge** — the wall-mount labor fee multiplied by the televisions mounted, rounded to the cent once, at the end, half up.

## Worked figures (hypothetical labor fee of $180.00)

| Television units sold | Television units returned | Televisions mounted | Charge |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 0 | 1 | $180.00 |
| 2 | 0 | 2 | $360.00 |
| 3 | 1 | 2 | $360.00 |
| 3 | 0 | 3 | $540.00 |
